svg.title: A nurse is teaching an older adult client who has mild hearing and vision changes. Which of the following actions should the nurse take? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Large print, brief repeated sessions, a quiet room, and clear face-to-face speech compensate for common age-related sensory changes. Raising pitch actually makes speech harder to hear because high tones are lost first, and teaching immediately after an opioid dose competes with sedation.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Teaching Older Adults
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching an older adult client
who has mild hearing and vision changes.
Which of the following actions should the
nurse take? Select all that apply.
What fits here
Use large, high-contrast print materials ·
Keep sessions short and repeat the key
points · Reduce background noise in the
room · Face the client and speak clearly
at a normal pace
Why it fits
Large print, brief repeated sessions, a
quiet room, and clear face-to-face speech
compensate for common age-related sensory
changes. Raising pitch actually makes
speech harder to hear because high tones
are lost first, and teaching immediately
after an opioid dose competes with
sedation.
